findings.title: Low ground plane fill ratio
findings.description: Ground zone on F.Cu has 52% fill ratio. Excessive routing or thermal relief patterns may be reducing ground plane effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Reduce routing density on this layer or move signals to other layers.
findings.summary: Low ground plane fill ratio

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J4
findings.description: Connector J4 (Conn_01x17) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J4. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J4

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J3
findings.description: J3 (Conn_01x17) has 1 ground pin(s) for 16 signal pins. Recommended: at least 4 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J3 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J3

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J4
findings.description: J4 (Conn_01x17) has 1 ground pin(s) for 16 signal pins. Recommended: at least 4 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J4 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J4

findings.title: Clock /stm32/clkout on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net /stm32/clkout is 100% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.
findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.
findings.summary: Clock /stm32/clkout on outer layer

findings.title: Clock /SCLK on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net /SCLK is 100% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.
findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.
findings.summary: Clock /SCLK on outer layer

findings.title: Clock TAG_SCK on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net TAG_SCK is 100% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.
findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.
findings.summary: Clock TAG_SCK on outer layer

findings.title: Clock /SCLK routed near connector J102
findings.description: Clock net /SCLK passes within 4.5mm of connector J102. Clock harmonics can couple to attached cables via proximity, increasing radiated emissions.
findings.recommendation: Route /SCLK away from J102, or add ground guard traces between the clock and connector.
findings.summary: Clock /SCLK routed near connector J102

findings.title: Clock /SCLK routed near connector J2
findings.description: Clock net /SCLK passes within 9.6mm of connector J2. Clock harmonics can couple to attached cables via proximity, increasing radiated emissions.
findings.recommendation: Route /SCLK away from J2, or add ground guard traces between the clock and connector.
findings.summary: Clock /SCLK routed near connector J2

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (53×74mm, εr=4.5) cavity resonances: (0,1) at 959 MHz; (1,0) at 1325 MHz; (1,1) at 1636 MHz; (0,2) at 1919 MHz; (1,2) at 2332 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: TAG_1V8
findings.description: Net TAG_1V8 has 5 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 5 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: TAG_1V8
